description: This file defines the yolov3 model architecture and detection layers for object detection. It includes class definitions for DetectionLayer, ConvLayer, and YoloV3, along with their methods implementing the neural network structure, forward passes, and some utility functions.

classes.name: DetectionLayer
classes.description: A PyTorch module representing a detection layer in the YOLOv3 architecture, responsible for processing model predictions and applying thresholds.

classes.name: ConvLayer
classes.description: A basic convolutional layer with optional batch normalization and activation, used to build the YOLOv3 network architecture.

classes.name: YoloV3
classes.description: The main YOLOv3 object detection model class, composed of many ConvLayers and DetectionLayers, with methods to perform forward pass and get loss layers.
